inspiration: Excellent-item glow stacks cheap layers: Fresnel edge term with steep exponent, three diagonal sweep beams with sharp falloff, hue cycling over time and UV (ItemMaterial.fx, lines near 371-405). Recreate with our own palette.

Echo copies: item and monster shaders sample the same sprite 4 to 6 times at small time-driven UV offsets and add them with falling weights (ItemMaterial.fx echo block; MonsterMaterial.fx:175). Cheap aura, not a blur.
Elite monster gold: tint multiplied into lit colour, 2x metallic gain (MonsterMaterial.fx:170), shimmer from time and normal. Use for elite creatures with our own tint ramp.
Shadow sampling: 2048 shadow map with a small averaged tap pattern (MonsterMaterial.fx:56, SampleShadow). Reference for soft contact shadows on creatures.
Light floor: one fixed directional light with minimum 0.1 on N dot L so back faces never go black.
Packed item options: one integer holds item level in the low bits and an excellent flag above, to drive VFX tiers from one number.
Cut-out sprites: alpha below 0.1 discarded in both shaders. Cheap and plain.

briefs.label: Edge-glow relic (top-tier drop)
briefs.why: A top-tier drop must read from across the arena. The edge glow separates the item from the background.
briefs.keep: Fresnel edge rim; sharp-falloff sweep beams; slow hue cycle
briefs.change: One hue family from our own palette; beams at our own angles; no rainbow

briefs.label: Gilded elite creature
briefs.why: An elite creature should look like it must be respected before it is fought.
briefs.keep: Tint multiply on lit colour; shimmer from time and normal; a brighter core
briefs.change: Our own tint ramp; shimmer tied to creature motion; glow only on the armour plates

briefs.label: Afterimage aura for spells
briefs.why: A spell trail that echoes gives motion without a new animation.
briefs.keep: Four echo copies; falling weights; time-driven small offsets
briefs.change: Echo only along the strike direction; our own weights; fade on a timer

briefs.label: Soft-shadow creature bed
briefs.why: Soft contact shadows ground creatures on any floor.
briefs.keep: Averaged small tap pattern; strength factor; bias term
briefs.change: Smaller map; a different tap pattern; our own strength curve
